Orange vs Blue

  1. Tap Play on your phone to join, and you'll be on Orange Team or Blue Team
  2. Each team starts from its corner, and you can only paint next to your team's color
  3. You start with 5 pixels, and get another every 5 seconds
  4. You'll get power-ups. Use each within 30 seconds: they can land anywhere, not just next to your color
  5. Whoever has the most of the board when time's up wins

Power-ups

Common

💣

Time Bomb

Paints a 3×3 your color, 10 seconds in the future.

🤫 Hidden from the other team

🌀

Time Loop

In 10 seconds, a 3×3 snaps back to how it looks right now.

🤫 Hidden from the other team

🔁

Groundhog Day

Paints a 3×3 your color every 5 seconds, 4 times over.

🤫 Hidden from the other team

⏪

Rewind

Puts a 3×3 back how it looked 15 seconds ago.

★ Rare

🚗

Back to the Future

For 10 seconds, your team paints 10 seconds in the future.

🐌

Lag

For 10 seconds, the other team paints 10 seconds in the past.

AshPaperTrail - Temporal Inline Mode

Caveats

  • Needs PostgreSQL 19, which is still in beta

    Temporal writes are UPDATE and DELETE ... FOR PORTION OF, new in 19. ETS works too.

  • Every read is a single point in time

    There's no read across the whole history of a record at once.

  • No cascades on PERIOD foreign keys

    Postgres rejects ON DELETE and ON UPDATE actions on them. Cascade in your app.

  • The actor is taken as it is

    Policies read data as of the moment you ask for, but not the actor you pass in.
